# Quiver

> Quiver is a small meta layer for Arrow.js apps: folder conventions (pages, layouts, middleware, views, app.config.js) built into one `quiver:app` module, routing on the Navigation API, guards and hooks, provide/inject and useMeta, in plain JavaScript with JSDoc types. Composables live in the separate `arrow-use` package; UI pieces (theme tokens, toasts, theme switcher, layouts, loading and error views, Link, useForm, hmrState) are copy-in recipes shipped in this package under `recipes/`.

This file ships inside `@go4cas/quiver`. Paths below are relative to the package folder (`node_modules/@go4cas/quiver/`).

Key facts:

- Startup: `import app from 'quiver:app'`, then `await createApp(app, { target: '#app', base })`. Register `beforeEach()`/`afterEach()`/`onError()` before it. The manual order is `provide()` → guards and hooks → `await initRouter({ routes, notFound, base, middleware })` → `createApp({ target, layouts, defaultLayout, loading, error })`.
- `quiver:app` is built from `src/` by `@go4cas/quiver/vite`, `@go4cas/quiver/bun`, or the `quiver app` CLI (writes `src/app.gen.js`): `pages/` (routes), `pages/**/_middleware.js` (section guards), `layouts/<name>.js`, `middleware/*.js` (global guards, file-name order), `views/loading.js` and `views/error.js`, `app.config.js` (each key provided by name), and each page's literal `meta.nav: { label, order }` (the `'nav'` list). `quiver:routes` (routes only) stays for the manual setup.
- All app-facing paths are base-relative; only `url(path)` adds the base.
- Arrow.js: values that change go in `() =>` slots; no HTML comments inside `html` templates; `.key(id)` in loops; `aria-disabled`, never `.disabled`.
- Recipes install by role into `src/components/`, `composables/`, `layouts/`, `views/` and `styles/` (the `files` map in `recipes/index.json`) and are then owned by the app; their CSS is plain CSS on `--q-*` tokens in `@layer quiver.*`.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): conventions, the 13 exports, Arrow.js pitfalls, recipes, CSS rules and testing, in one file
- [Package README](README.md): install and a minimal example
- [Recipes](recipes/README.md): what each recipe is and how to install one
- [Recipe registry](recipes/index.json): every recipe with its files, CSS, dependencies and aliases
- [Virtual module types](client.d.ts): `quiver:app` and `quiver:routes`

## Recipes

- [theme](recipes/theme/README.md): `--q-*` token contract, reset, optional per-theme effects
- [toasts](recipes/toasts/README.md): `useToast()`, `toastState`, `ToastContainer`
- [theme-switcher](recipes/theme-switcher/README.md): persisted theme and light/dark mode
- [layouts](recipes/layouts/README.md): `layouts/default.js` (centred card), `layouts/menu.js` (sidebar + header)
- [views](recipes/views/README.md): `views/loading.js`, `views/error.js` with retry
- [link](recipes/link/README.md): `Link` with `aria-current` and `data-active`
- [useForm](recipes/useForm/README.md): form state, validation and submit
- [hmrState](recipes/hmrState/README.md): state kept across Vite hot reloads

## Optional

- [Documentation site](https://go4cas.github.io/quiver/): guides for app structure, routing, middleware, layouts, state, theming and testing
- [API reference](https://go4cas.github.io/quiver/api/): every export of `@go4cas/quiver`, `/vite`, `/bun`, `/client`, the `quiver` CLI and `arrow-use`
- [Migrating from 2.x](https://go4cas.github.io/quiver/guide/migration): what moved where, and the behaviour changes
- [Source and starter app](https://github.com/go4cas/quiver): `bunx degit go4cas/quiver/starter my-app`
- [arrow-use](https://github.com/go4cas/quiver/tree/main/packages/arrow-use): `useFetch`, `useStorage`, `useMediaQuery`, `useEventListener`
- [Arrow.js](https://arrow-js.com): the reactive template library Quiver builds on
